license_source: Owner-authored limited valency, semantic classes, named-entity and function-word roles; Brown POS and dictionary do not establish those relations.
forms: Current completion recipes use dictionary-supported base forms. Existing typed_constituents.VERBS third/past forms and agreement_morphology regular realizations are supported by the realizer but are not searched in this run. No third/past generation claim.
constructor_obligations: Local recipes: negative action + controlled second imperative; direct question object with temporal subordinate clause; purpose imperative; modal pause/wait with purpose. No global complement_type binding.
letter_selection: Partial lexical states are compared before a full phrase is rendered; main search adds whole parsed chunks only.
coverage: Finite authored grammar/semantic support over existing frozen lexical resources, not a general English phrase parser.
